text.title: Sea Salt Anchor
text.declared_genre: Dark Indietronica / Deep Space Dub / Slow Ambient Bass
text.declared_mood: Seduced and ashamed -> recognition -> unsteady refusal
text.production_notes: Sub-bass undertow, sparse piano, rim clicks (grains on glass), low organ. Tape delay on 'anchor' only. Sudden vacuum drop before bridge. Final section: percussion cut, raw breath against sub-bass.
text.vocal_notes: Close, intimate androgynous lead; Verse: low/controlled. Hook: strained/distorted. Bridge: breathy whisper. Final Hook: thin/raw human texture. Low octave shadow on 'anchor'.
section_names: Verse 2 - dub echoes | wide spatial depth
Rupture - heavy sub hit | sudden silence
Final Hook - percussion removed | raw/thin vocal
Outro - breath & sub-bass | long delay tail
